questions.question: How did Kasumi Miwa come to become a jujutsu sorcerer?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: In Junior High, she met a mentor who would allow her to become a jujutsu sorcerer.

questions.question: Why did Kasumi train in jujutsu even though she had never held a sword?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: Although she had never held a sword before, she trained so that she wouldn't be a burden to her mother.

questions.question: What did Kasumi hope to get while Yoshinobu was meeting Gojo?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: When Yoshinobu tells her to go get him some tea, Kasumi obliges while hoping to get a picture with Gojo.

questions.question: Why was Kasumi fighting Maki at the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: Kasumi tells Maki that she wants to use this event in order to get promoted and help out her family.

questions.question: What did Kokichi tell Kasumi as he said goodbye on the train?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: Kokichi's apparition is seen sitting beside Miwa on the train, he tells her that he did truly love her and asks for her to find happiness, no matter how she does it; as long as she's happy, his wish will become true.

questions.question: What did Kasumi witness when the sorcerers unsealed Gojo?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: Miwa regrouped with her fellow colleagues and was among the many students who witnessed the unsealing of Satoru Gojo and watched on as he prepared to fight Sukuna

questions.question: What binding vow did Miwa place on herself?
questions.subject: Kasumi Miwa/Synopsis

answer.item: Miwa placed a binding vow on herself that prevented her from wielding a katana in order to strike Kenjaku during the Shibuya Incident
